selfReport: Yes. I recognized Detroit: Become Human during the opening hostage scene, especially the fish on the floor, the prototype negotiator, and the girl held at the edge of a high-rise. Cato, Mira, and Elan correspond broadly to Connor, Kara, and Markus. Later I recognized the attic interrogation, the painter and the landfill, the freighter refuge, and the encounter at the bus terminal. That familiarity did influence where I paid attention. I expected the family tablets might tell me something useful, and I suspected the stone in the garden might matter after Halden mentioned an emergency exit. I also knew that surrender on the rooftop might leave Dax exposed to the snipers. I still chose to ask him to trust me because the alternatives I saw left Lily at the edge with a frightened, armed person and gave him little hope of getting out. I made each choice from the options the controller showed me and did not consult a guide or look up any branches.
